name: Gnome
summary: Small, curious and full of energy. Gnomes love inventions, illusions, jokes and learning, and their quick minds shrug off magic aimed at them.

age.summary: Gnomes come of age around 40 and can live 350 to almost 500 years.

alignment.summary: Gnomes are usually good; tinkerers lean lawful, tricksters lean chaotic.

size.description: Gnomes stand 3 to 4 feet tall and weigh about 40 pounds.

speed.description: Your base walking speed is 25 feet.

languages.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Gnomish.

features.name: Darkvision
features.summary: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light (shades of gray only).

features.name: Gnome Cunning
features.summary: You have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saving throws against magic.

sublineages.name: Forest Gnome
sublineages.summary: Forest gnomes live hidden in the woods, with a gift for small illusions and a bond with little animals.

features.name: Natural Illusionist
features.summary: You know the minor illusion cantrip. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

features.name: Speak with Small Beasts
features.summary: Through sounds and gestures, you can share simple ideas with Small or smaller beasts.

sublineages.name: Rock Gnome
sublineages.summary: Rock gnomes are tinkerers and inventors, hardy and endlessly curious about how things work.

features.name: Artificer's Lore
features.summary: On History checks about magic items, alchemical objects or technological devices, add double your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Tinker
features.summary: You are proficient with tinker's tools and can build tiny clockwork toys, fire starters and music boxes.
